ML datasets require clinical validation and bias review.

Production hosting, load testing and accessibility work remain pending.
Clinician review workflows and clearer safety escalation.
Calibration, fairness analysis and explainable prediction output.
Encrypted managed storage, monitoring, backup and automated testing.
AarogyamCareAI combines a React interface, Node/Express services, MySQL persistence, FastAPI prediction models and server-side Gemini integration in one healthcare-information application.
Health profile, chat, reports, predictions and appointments in one account.
Gemini supports educational chat and report summaries.
Disease and cardiovascular risk features include explicit safety limits.
